prompt: Painterly cinematic realism with Old-Master light, one warm grade, fine film grain. Wide shot. Animals in pairs walk side by side up a dusty bare hillside path toward the hilltop: two camels, two oxen and two goats, one pair behind another. At the edge of the path three small dark figures in hooded ankle-length robes of rough brown wool, barefoot, seen from behind, stand aside and watch them pass. Bare rocky hills, dry grass. Evening, warm low sun and long shadows. Ordered and strange. The ancient Near East in the days of the flood: the open water, the mountains of Ararat and the empty new earth. No stone buildings, towers, churches, glass lanterns, modern clothing or roads. No text, no logos.
